items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: when I was at Chinatown, you had Louis Primer used to be there every night

ctx.x: What's the band you play with?

Yeah, Red played or I'd live too. Well I mean we played by air or whatever you might call it. Because some of them groups now you take like Coo Coo and George Lewis and them, well they come back playing music again after Shark and them brought them back when they started Dixieland back on Boyleville Street. But you see them fellas, when we was ridin' all that hell around there with these bands, and when I was at Chinatown, you had Louis Primer used to be there every night, you understand? And all them big bands…
I wanted to ask you, who is Willie Kuyfer? You ever hear of Willie Kuyfer?
